matched_compute_result.description: 1,320 optimizer updates over 1,351,680 unique CC3M-mirror pairs

narrow_claim: Under a compute budget matched to the COCO control, and with an LR pinned from COCO and explicitly untuned for this CC3M mirror, the CC3M-mirror subset underperformed COCO-trained transfer by 8.13pp at matched compute and 5.89pp after four passes.
prominent_counterargument: Seeds 42 and 43 were still improving at the 5,280-step ceiling, early stopping never fired, and the extended-training arm recovered 2.23pp over the matched-compute arm. The experiment does not establish that CC3M-mirror training cannot overtake COCO with more compute; it establishes that it did not do so within the pre-registered budget.
cross_distribution_result: The prior pilot found that unique COCO coverage beat repeated COCO coverage by 15.03pp at 1,320 steps. At the same 1,320-step budget, 1,351,680 unique CC3M-mirror pairs underperformed the COCO-trained locked recipe by 8.13pp. Unique-pair coverage therefore helped within distribution and hurt across distribution at this scale. The result indicates that caption and distribution properties matter more than pair count alone under this budget; it does not isolate a caption-quality mechanism.
interpretive_limit: Human-written, retrieval-shaped COCO captions and web alt-text differ in multiple coupled properties. Caption properties are a plausible explanation, not an identified causal mechanism.
prohibited_follow_up_without_new_preregi: evaluating either CC3M arm on Flickr30k test
adding either CC3M arm to the final efficiency frontier
